definition_en: brightness that makes things visible; not heavy in weight
core_image: 让黑暗或重量没有负担
scene: 拎起朋友的包说 Wow, this is light!
sceneCN: 这里 light 是「轻的」（第 5 个义项：重量小）；句意：哇，这个（包）好轻！

pos.zh: 轻的；浅色的；轻微的；轻松的

collocations.zh: 点亮；照亮；（脸上）露出喜色

forms.label: 比较级（形容词“轻的／浅的”）
最高级（形容词“轻的／浅的”）

derivatives.zh: 打火机（也可作形容词 light 的比较级）

senses.title: Light: brightness that lets you see
senses.definition: the natural energy from the sun, or brightness from a lamp, that makes things visible
senses.example: The light in this room is too bright.
senses.why: Core sense: light removes darkness, and with darkness removed, things become visible. Every other sense of 'light' starts from this visible-energy image.
senses.whyCN: 核心义：光让黑暗消失，黑暗消失后事物就可见。light 的其他含义都从这个“可见的能量”意象出发。

senses.title: A light: a lamp or a source of light
senses.definition: a device or a source that produces light, such as a lamp
senses.why: Metonymy: the thing that carries the brightness is called by the brightness itself. The source stands for the light it gives.
senses.whyCN: 转喻：承载光亮的东西直接用“光”来称呼。光源代替了它所发出的光。

senses.title: Light: set something burning
senses.definition: to make something start to burn
senses.example: She lit a candle and sat down.
senses.exampleCN: 她点了一支蜡烛，然后坐下。
senses.why: Fire is a source of light. To make fire start is to bring that light into existence, so the verb light means 'cause to give light by burning'.
senses.whyCN: 火是光的来源。让火开始，就是让那种光出现，所以动词 light 表示“使燃烧而发光”。

senses.title: Light: give light to a place
senses.definition: to give light to a place or thing
senses.example: The whole street was lit by the setting sun.
senses.why: The same light-energy is now directed onto an object. The object moves from dark to visible, which is the core change.
senses.whyCN: 同一种光能被导向某个对象；对象从暗变亮，这正是核心变化。

senses.title: Light: not heavy
senses.example: This bag is light enough to carry all day.
senses.exampleCN: 这个包很轻，可以整天提着。
senses.why: This is a different word that happens to share the spelling. Its own core is 'little weight', so a light load is a load that does not press on you.
senses.whyCN: 这是另一个恰好同形的词。它自己的核心是“重量小”，所以 light 的负担是不会压着你的负担。

senses.title: Light: pale in colour
senses.example: She painted the walls light blue.
senses.why: Colour is judged by how much light it seems to hold. A pale colour looks 'full of light', so light came to mean the opposite of dark in colour too.
senses.whyCN: 人们用“含光量”来判断颜色：浅色看起来“充满光”，于是 light 也从“光线充足”引申为颜色上的“淡”。

senses.title: Light: not great in amount or force
senses.definition: not great in amount, force, or severity
senses.definitionCN: 轻微的；少量的；不严重的
senses.example: A light rain began to fall.
senses.why: From 'little weight' comes 'little force': a light rain, a light touch, a light punishment all carry little weight or pressure.
senses.whyCN: 从“重量小”引申出“力度小”：小雨、轻触、轻罚，都是分量或压力很小的东西。

senses.title: Light: not serious or difficult
senses.definition: not serious, difficult, or heavy in tone
senses.definitionCN: 轻松的；不严肃的；供消遣的
senses.example: We watched a light comedy after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭后我们看了一部轻松喜剧。
senses.why: Something without weight is easy to carry. A task or a story without 'weight' is easy to bear, so light means entertaining and not serious.
senses.whyCN: 没有重量的东西容易拿；没有“分量”的任务或故事也容易承受，于是 light 表示轻松、不严肃。

senses.title: Come to light: become known
senses.titleCN: 显露：被人看见、为人所知
senses.definition: to become known or visible, especially after being hidden
senses.example: New facts came to light during the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 审判过程中新的证据被披露出来。
senses.why: Hidden things are in darkness; when they come into the light, they become visible. Knowledge is treated as sight.
senses.whyCN: 隐藏的事物处在黑暗里；一旦进入光中，就变得可见。知识被当作“看见”。

senses.title: In a new light: from a different view
senses.definition: a particular way of considering something
senses.definitionCN: （in a new/different light）从新的角度；以不同的眼光
senses.example: The letter made her see his decision in a new light.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信让她从新的角度看待他的决定。
senses.why: Lighting determines what you can see and how it looks. A different light on an object is a different view of it.
senses.whyCN: 光线决定你能看见什么、它看起来怎样。换一束光照同一个对象，就是换一个视角看它。

intro.en: The spelling light hides two different words: one from 'bright', one from 'not heavy'. Both were lēoht in Old English and fell together in Modern English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: light 这个拼写下藏着两个不同的词：一个来自“明亮”，一个来自“不重”。它们在古英语里都写作 lēoht，在现代英语中合成了一个同形词。年代为大致估计。

items.en: lēoht (West Saxon), lēht (Anglian) meant 'light, daylight; bright, shining', as both noun and adjective. The -gh- spelling was later added by Anglo-French scribes to show the Germanic h-sound.
items.cn: lēoht（西撒克逊）、lēht（盎格利亚）意为“光、日光；明亮的、发光的”，既是名词也是形容词。后来的 -gh- 拼法是盎格鲁-法语抄写员为了标出日耳曼语的 h 音而加的。

items.en: From Proto-Germanic *leuhtą / *leuhta- (German Licht, Dutch licht, Gothic liuhaþ), from PIE *leuk- 'light, brightness'. Latin lux, lūcis 'light' and lūmen 'light' come from the same root, as does Greek leukos 'white'.
items.cn: 来自原始日耳曼语 *leuhtą / *leuhta-（德语 Licht、荷兰语 licht、哥特语 liuhaþ），再往前是原始印欧语 *leuk-“光、明亮”。拉丁语 lux、lūcis“光”和 lūmen“光”同出这一词根，希腊语 leukos“白”也是。

items.en: A separate lēoht meant 'not heavy, lightly built; easy, slight, quick'. It comes from Proto-Germanic *lingkhtaz (Old Norse léttr, German leicht, Dutch licht, Gothic leihts), from PIE *legwh- 'not heavy'.
items.cn: 另一个 lēoht 意为“不重、结构轻巧；容易的、轻微的、敏捷的”。它来自原始日耳曼语 *lingkhtaz（古诺斯语 léttr、德语 leicht、荷兰语 licht、哥特语 leihts），再往前是原始印欧语 *legwh-“不重”。

items.en: Standard etymological dictionaries treat the 'bright' light and the 'not heavy' light as different words from different roots. A few older popular accounts try to connect them through 'bright, clear → easy', but that link is not generally accepted.
items.cn: 标准词源词典把“明亮”的 light 和“不重”的 light 看作来自不同词根的两个词。少数较早的通俗说法试图用“明亮、清楚 → 容易”把两者连起来，但这一联系并未被普遍接受。

items.en: Latin lux / lūcis and lūmen gave English lucid, translucent, luminous and illuminate. Greek leukos 'white' gave leukemia and leukocyte. These are cognates of the 'brightness' light through PIE *leuk-, not borrowings of the English word.
items.cn: 拉丁语 lux / lūcis 和 lūmen 产生了英语 lucid、translucent、luminous、illuminate。希腊语 leukos“白”产生了 leukemia、leukocyte。它们通过原始印欧语 *leuk- 与“明亮”义的 light 同源，并不是直接借用了英语这个词。

items.en: The verb has two paths: light 'ignite / illuminate' comes from Old English līhtan (from the noun), while light 'alight, get down' comes from līhtan 'make light, relieve of weight' — a rare crossing between the two families. The past tense is lit, with lighted kept in attributive and compound uses.
items.cn: 动词有两条来路：表示“点燃／照亮”的 light 来自古英语 līhtan（源自名词）；表示“下车、下来”的 light 来自 līhtan“使变轻、卸下重量”——这是两个词族少见的交叉。过去式常用 lit，lighted 多保留在定语和复合词中。

note.en: Words below can be confused with light. The notes point to sound and spelling first, then meaning.
note.cn: 下面这些词容易和 light 混淆。说明先讲读音和拼写，再讲意思。

entries.definition: an informal or advertising spelling of light, used for low-calorie or low-fat products. It works as an adjective, not as a verb or a lamp.
entries.definitionCN: light 的非正式／广告拼法，常用于低热量、低脂产品。它只作形容词，不作动词或“灯”。

entries.definition: a verb meaning to get off a bus, train, or other vehicle; also an adjective meaning 'burning'. The extra a- changes both form and meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，表示从公共汽车、火车等下来；也可作形容词，表示“燃烧着的”。多出的 a- 让形式和意思都变了。

entries.definition: great pleasure; to please someone greatly. It begins with de-, not with l-, so it is not a form of light.
entries.definitionCN: 高兴；使某人非常愉快。它以 de- 开头，不是 l- 开头，所以不是 light 的某种形式。

entries.definition: adjective: small in degree; verb: to treat someone without respect. It adds s- before light.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词：轻微的、细小的；动词：轻视、怠慢。它在 light 前多一个 s-。

entries.definition: noun: the ability to see, or something you see. It has no l, so it is sight, not slight or light.
entries.definitionCN: 视力；景象（名词）。它没有 l，所以是 sight，不是 slight 或 light。

entries.definition: noun: the dark part of the day. It starts with n- instead of l-, and is the opposite of day.
entries.definitionCN: 夜晚（名词）。它以 n- 开头而不是 l-，正是“白天”的反面。

entries.definition: noun: the bright flash in a storm. It is written without the e of lightening and has only two syllables.
entries.definitionCN: 闪电（名词）。拼写中没有 lightening 里的 e，只有两个音节。

entries.definition: the -ing form of lighten: making something lighter or brighter. It keeps the e and has three syllables; it is not lightning.
entries.definitionCN: lighten 的 -ing 形式：使变轻或变亮的过程。它保留 e，有三个音节；它不是“闪电”。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real, explainable links — real compounds and common phrases, not made-up rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实、可解释的联系——真实的复合词和常见短语，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: daylight = day + light: the light that belongs to the day.
normal.cn: daylight = day + light：属于白天的光，也就是日光。

normal.en: lighthouse = light + house: a house that holds a light to guide ships.
normal.cn: lighthouse = light + house：一座装着灯、用来指引船只的房子，也就是灯塔。

normal.en: lighten does two jobs: light (adj. not heavy) + -en = make less heavy; light (noun) + -en = make brighter.
normal.cn: lighten 有两个工作：light（形容词“轻”）+ -en = 使变轻；light（名词“光”）+ -en = 使变亮。

normal.en: lightning is the flash in a storm; lightening is the act of making something lighter or brighter. The e makes it the slow process, not the flash.
normal.cn: lightning 是暴风雨中的闪电；lightening 是使某物变轻或变亮的过程。多出的 e 表示这是一个过程，而不是那道闪光。

normal.en: shed light on something = make it clear. Light reveals what was hidden, and understanding is pictured as seeing.
normal.cn: shed light on something = 把某事讲清楚。光让隐藏的东西显露出来，而理解被想象成“看见”。

abstract.en: Light is a switch from hidden to seen. Symbol: ☾ → ☀ — a dark field becomes a lit field, and every shape in it appears.
abstract.cn: light 是从“隐藏”到“可见”的一次切换。符号：☾ → ☀——暗下来的场变成被照亮的场，里面每一个形状都显现出来。

abstract.en: The weight-light is a second switch: a load loses mass until it barely presses down. Same spelling, different origin — do not force one metaphor onto both.
abstract.cn: 表示“轻”的 light 是第二个开关：负担不断减少重量，直到几乎不再压下来。拼写相同，来源不同——不要把同一个比喻硬套到两者身上。

abstract.en: The extended senses follow visibility: what is lit can be seen, what is seen can be understood, and the angle of the light is the angle of the view.
abstract.cn: 引申义沿着“可见性”展开：被照亮的东西能被看见，被看见的东西能被理解，而光的角度就是看问题的角度。

examples.en: Turn off the light before you leave.
This jacket is very light, so it is good for summer.
examples.cn: 这件夹克很轻，所以适合夏天穿。

examples.en: The truth finally came to light.

dict_mnemonic.text: 来特（light）—— 光来得特别亮，是“光”；拎起来特别轻，是“轻” → light

root: 两个同形异源的古英语词：lēoht“光”与 lēoht“轻”，分别来自印欧词根 *leuk- 和 *legwh-。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of light. Two source words share one spelling: brightness removes darkness, while little weight removes pressure.
sensesIntro.cn: light 的十个常见义项。两个来源不同的词共用同一个拼写：明亮驱散黑暗，轻巧卸下压力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: darkness or weight is removed, so what was hidden or heavy becomes visible or easy.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗或重量被移走，原本被遮住或压住的东西变得可见、可承受。

branches.en: VISIBLE ENERGY: light itself, its source, setting it alight, and throwing it on a place.
branches.cn: 可见的能量：光本身、光的来源、把火点着、把光投向某处。

branches.en: COLOUR AND VIEW: how much light a colour seems to carry; which light you see an object in.
branches.cn: 颜色与视角：一种颜色看起来含多少光；你从哪束光里看一个对象。

branches.en: KNOWLEDGE AS SIGHT: hidden facts enter the light and become known.
branches.cn: 知识即看见：隐藏的事实进入光中，就被人知道。

branches.en: WEIGHT REMOVED: a second, unrelated 'light' — little weight → little force → little seriousness.
branches.cn: 重量被移走：另一个来源无关的 light——重量小 → 力度小 → 严肃性小。

branches.en: HOMONYM NOTE: the left track belongs to the 'brightness' word; the right track belongs to the 'not heavy' word.
branches.cn: 同形异源提示：左边这条轨道属于“明亮”那个词；右边这条轨道属于“不重”那个词。

intro.en: Light is a highly productive root in two ways: it forms words about brightness and words about lightness of weight. Prefixes and suffixes send both cores into everyday vocabulary.
intro.cn: light 是一个高度能产的词根，有两条路：一条构成与“光”有关的词，一条构成与“轻”有关的词。前缀和后缀把这两个核心带进大量日常词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin lux / lūcis 'light' and lūmen 'light' are cognates of the brightness-light through PIE *leuk-. This family is not borrowed from the English word; it is a distant relative. Greek leukos 'white' belongs to the same root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 lux / lūcis“光”和 lūmen“光”通过原始印欧语 *leuk- 与“明亮”义的 light 同源。这一族不是从英语这个词借出去的，而是远亲。希腊语 leukos“白”也属于同一词根。

items.meaning: to make or become less heavy
items.meaningCN: 使变轻；减轻（-en 表示“使……”，这里来自形容词“轻的”）
items.example: We lightened the load by leaving the tent behind.
items.exampleCN: 我们把帐篷留下，减轻了负担。

items.meaningCN: 使变亮；照亮（同形动词的另一支，来自名词“光”）
items.example: A few lamps lightened the dark room.
items.exampleCN: 几盏灯照亮了昏暗的房间。

items.meaning: gently; with little weight or force
items.meaningCN: 轻轻地；轻微地（-ly 是副词后缀）
items.exampleCN: 她轻轻碰了碰他的肩膀。

items.meaning: to give someone knowledge or understanding
items.meaningCN: 启发；使明白（en- 表示“使进入”，lighten 表示“使变亮”）
items.example: The book enlightened me about the subject.
items.exampleCN: 这本书让我对这个主题有了新的认识。

items.meaning: the natural light of the day
items.example: We finished the work before daylight faded.
items.exampleCN: 我们在天色暗下来之前完成了工作。

items.meaning: the large lamp at the front of a vehicle
weighing less than usual; also not serious or important
items.example: She bought a lightweight jacket for the trip.
items.exampleCN: 她为这次旅行买了一件轻便夹克。

items.meaning: the arrangement or equipment that gives light
items.meaningCN: 照明；灯光设备（-ing 构成名词，表示行为或结果）
items.example: The stage lighting was too dim.

items.meaning: a tower with a light that guides ships
items.example: The lighthouse stands at the end of the harbour.

latinEntries.meaningCN: 清晰的；明白易懂的（luc- 表示“光”）
发光的；明亮的（-ous 表示“充满……的”）

latinEntries.meaning: to light up; to make clear
